title.zh: Citrini观点：Terafab全面排除中国供应商，要求韩企报价低于中国厂商
title.en: Citrini观点：Terafab全面排除中国供应商，要求韩企报价低于中国厂商

current_state.zh: Citrini analyst Jukan says Musk's Tesla/SpaceX Terafab semiconductor project is excluding Chinese suppliers, seeking Korean vendors with aggressive pricing, and targeting roughly 100,000 wafers per month by 2030 while exploring partnerships with Intel and TSMC.
